rows.heading: Time-Bound Promotion Channel (E1→E4)
rows.quote_snippet: 2.1 Qualifying Residency Requirements: Promotions within the junior executive ranks (E1 through E4) shall be governed by the Time-Bound Promotion Channel subject to completing prescribed residency and meeting the APAR benchmark: (a) Promotion from E1 to E2: 3 (three) completed years of qualifying residency service at Grade E1. (b) Promotion from E2 to E3: 3 (three) completed years of qualifying residency service at Grade E2. (c) Promotion from E3 to E4: 3 to 4 (three to four) completed years of qualifying residency service at Grade E3. 2.2 Non-Vacancy Based Progression: In the time-bound channel, promotions are not constrained by fixed budgetary post vacancies; all officers who complete the qualifying residency and achieve the required performance rating and vigilance clearance shall be promoted. 2.3 Effective Date of Promotion: Time-bound promotions shall take effect from 1st January or 1st July following completion of qualifying residency.

rows.heading: APAR Benchmark for Time-Bound Promotion
rows.quote_snippet: 3.1 Performance Benchmark Threshold: To qualify for time-bound promotion, an executive must maintain a consistent track record of satisfactory performance across the qualifying residency years: (a) For E1→E2: Minimum cumulative rating of 'Good' (score ≥ 3.0 / 60%) in the annual e-APAR ratings for the preceding 3 years. (b) For E2→E3: Minimum cumulative rating of 'Good' to 'Very Good' (score ≥ 3.5 / 70%) across the preceding 3 years, with no adverse remark. (c) For E3→E4: Minimum cumulative rating of 'Very Good' (score ≥ 3.5 / 70%) across the preceding residency period. 3.2 Adverse Remark Disqualification: Any uncommunicated or sustained adverse remark, or an APAR rating below 'Good' in any single year, shall result in deferment of promotion by one year until the benchmark is restored.

rows.heading: Vigilance Clearance as Pre-Condition
rows.quote_snippet: 7.1 Mandatory Vigilance Clearance: Clear and unconditional vigilance clearance from the Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO) is a non-negotiable mandatory prerequisite for placing any officer on the promotion panel or releasing promotion orders. 7.2 Disqualifying Vigilance Status: An officer shall not be granted promotion if: (a) under suspension; (b) a charge-sheet for major penalty disciplinary proceedings under CDA Rule 14 has been issued; or (c) prosecution for a criminal charge is pending.
